                # Try all possible splits between i and j
                left_val = 1 if dp[i][k] else 0
                right_val = 1 if dp[k+1][j] else 0
                # The implication is (left_val -> right_val)
                # We want to see if this can be 0

                        right_expr = str(a[k+1])

                    break
            else:
                # If no split gives 0, check if the entire subarray can be 0 without splitting
                # This is only possible if the entire subarray is a single 0
                if length == 1:
                    dp[i][j] = (a[i] == 0)
                else:
                    # Check if the entire subarray can be evaluated left-to-right to 0
                    current = a[i]
                    for m in range(i+1, j+1):

                    dp[i][j] = (current == 0)
                    if dp[i][j]:
                        expr[i][j] = '->'.join(map(str, a[i:j+1]))

    if dp[0][n-1]:
        print("YES")
        print(expr[0][n-1])

        print("NO")
